title: Strict coherent Cech coefficient maps

source.place: Tags 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor), 070I (lemma-K-injective); agent coefficient-comparison extension of the injective Cech argument, returned proof step 8.

lean.statement:
theorem cech_coefficient_strict_maps
    {C Y : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory Y]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {L : GrothendieckTopology Y}
    {R R' : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}} {S S' : Sheaf L RingCat.{u}}
    {f : RingedToposMorphism R S} {f' : RingedToposMorphism R' S'}
    {φ : R' ⟶ R} {ψ : S' ⟶ S} {hd : f.direct = f'.direct}
    {D : CoherentCechImageModel R} {D' : CoherentCechImageModel R'}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wYp} (ringedSiteModules.{u} S')]
    (E : CechCoefficientCommutations f f' φ ψ hd D D')
    (I : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u} R) ℕ)
    (I' : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u} R') ℕ) :
    ∃ (maps : ∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u))
        (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I ⟶ I'),
        CechCoefficientMapData E V I I' t)
      (b : ∀ V : Sheaf J (Type u),
        (f.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I ⟶
          (D.bicomplex f.modules V I).total (.up ℕ))
      (b' : ∀ V : Sheaf J (Type u),
        (f'.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I' ⟶
          (D'.bicomplex f'.modules V I').total (.up ℕ)),
      (∀ V : Sheaf J (Type u), D.IsAugmentation f.modules V I (b V) ∧
        D'.IsAugmentation f'.modules V I' (b' V)) ∧
      (∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u)) (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I ⟶ I'),
        (cechCoefficientComplex ψ (.up ℤ)).map
            (cechCoefficientExtendMap f.modules (b V)) ≫
          cechCoefficientExtendMap (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ) (maps V t).total =
        (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex E.base.hom (.up ℤ)).app
            (I.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ≫
          (f'.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (cechCoefficientLiftExtend φ t) ≫
            cechCoefficientExtendMap f'.modules (b' V)) ∧
      (∀ (V : Sheaf J (Type u)) (t₀ t₁ :
          (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I ⟶ I'),
        Nonempty (Homotopy t₀ t₁) →
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (maps V t₀).total
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (maps V t₁).total
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
            ((maps V t₀).bicomplex.f n) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
            ((maps V t₁).bicomplex.f n) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ∧
      (∀ (V W : Sheaf J (Type u)) (r : W ⟶ V)
        (t : (cechCoefficientComplex φ (.up ℕ)).obj I ⟶ I'),
        (cechCoefficientComplex ψ (.up ℕ)).map
            (D.totalRefinement f.modules r I) ≫ (maps W t).total =
          (maps V t).total ≫ D'.totalRefinement f'.modules r I' ∧
        ∀ n q : ℕ,
          (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ψ).map (f.modules.map
              ((D.image.map (((Arrow.mapCechNerve
                (Arrow.homMk r (𝟙 _) (terminal.hom_ext _ _) :
                  Arrow.mk (terminal.from W) ⟶ Arrow.mk (terminal.from V))).app
                  (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op)).app (I.X q))) ≫
            ((maps W t).bicomplex.f n).f q =
          ((maps V t).bicomplex.f n).f q ≫ f'.modules.map
            ((D'.image.map (((Arrow.mapCechNerve
              (Arrow.homMk r (𝟙 _) (terminal.hom_ext _ _) :
                  Arrow.mk (terminal.from W) ⟶ Arrow.mk (terminal.from V))).app
                (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).op)).app (I'.X q)))

statement: For coherent Cech image models and canonical scalar commutations [def-sfb-cech-coefficient-comparison-data], and arbitrary nonnegative complexes I and J of module sheaves, there are the actual coefficient bicomplex maps, finite-diagonal total maps [def-sp-double-complex-total], and localization-unit augmentations. Their components are the specified base and image scalar identifications followed by t. The chain augmentation square commutes after extension by zero; homotopic t induce equal total and column maps after Q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; and the actual cover refinement squares commute. No resolution, K-injectivity, or right-derived comparison is involved.

proof.text: Transpose the scalar commutations using the counit mate equation and the localization adjunctions. The triangle identities give unit compatibility; the sectionwise identity gives relocalization compatibility. Thus the scalar image isomorphisms are natural in the localizing sheaf.

Whisker the resulting natural transformation with the covering nerve. Apply alternating cofaces, then termwise complex functors and flip; compose with the map induced by t. Totalize through the inverse finite-coproduct comparison. This gives exactly every required component and total coprojection equation.

Insert each localization unit at (0,q) using the unique augmentation [lem-sfb-cech-augmentation-normalized-naturality]. The unit compatibility and naturality at t give the chain square. Extend by zero using the map-extension natural isomorphism.

Map a homotopy through the primed cochains, composing with the fixed coefficient transformation. The signed total homotopy [lem-sfb-cech-augmentation-normalized-naturality] has (-1)^n on column n and zero at q=0. Apply Q after extension to identify the maps. Naturality in nerve maps gives the component refinement square, and total coprojections give the total square.
